ideas.idea: Add /features link to main nav or change the div to a Link
ideas.why: Duplicates a known problem about /features being reached only via div onClick, but it is accurate; however it is already graded, so treat as known.

ideas.idea: Back up the 'integrates with all the tools' claim by listing real integrations
ideas.why: The home page makes the vague claim at _index.tsx:8 and names no tool, so a concrete list gives readers and machines something to quote.

ideas.idea: Add plan names, contents and prices to the pricing page
ideas.why: pricing.tsx has only a vague sentence and no plan information, so concrete content helps users and machines understand the page.

ideas.idea: Flesh out the Features page with a section per feature
ideas.why: features.tsx names three features and describes none, so more content would help readers and machines.

ideas.idea: Give the changelog dated entries and version headings, maybe a page per release
ideas.why: changelog.tsx renders bare strings with no dates or headings, so structure would help readers and machines.
